tokens.name: play-ground
tokens.usage: Child app page background. ink, ink-muted and every *-ink token read on it.

tokens.name: family-ground
tokens.usage: Parent dashboard and website page background. ink, ink-muted, action and danger read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, answer tiles, dialogs and menus, on either ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, input fields, progress tracks and the Not started status.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card or input borders. In High contrast it becomes a 3:1 border that separates surfaces.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning, such as an unselected answer tile or a checkbox edge: 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on play-ground, family-ground, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on play-ground, family-ground, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Not on the soft tints.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Main child-app fill: the primary play button, the current step, highlights. Text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Warm accent fill: Review cards and celebration shapes. Never means wrong. Text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Cool accent fill: secondary play buttons, New-skill art, the selected answer. Text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Correct answers, completed steps and Mastered. Text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Parent-world brand fill for charts, illustration and the cover. Decorative only: never put text on teal; use action for buttons.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deep brand fill: website hero bands and dark blocks. Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sun, coral, sky and leaf fills.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Background for Try again feedback, the New kicker and the Building status, behind sun-ink or ink.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sun-soft or any ground: Try again feedback and the Building status.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the Review kicker and the Review due status, behind coral-ink or ink.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral-soft or any ground: Review and Review due.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Background for hints, the Your choice kicker, the selected answer tile and the Exploring status.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sky-soft or any ground: hints and Exploring.

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Background for correct feedback, a correct answer tile and the Mastered status.

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on leaf-soft or any ground: correct feedback and Mastered.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the Strong status and calm parent highlights.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal-soft or any ground: the Strong status.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Parent primary buttons and links, on family-ground and the surfaces. Its label is on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Parent-side form errors and destructive actions only, always with an icon and words, on family-ground and the surfaces. Never in the child app.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour, 3:1 on every ground in every theme. Applied through the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in parent copy. An alias of action, so links follow it in every theme.

families.display: "Baloo 2", "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Play
groups.note: Baloo 2: rounded and chunky, with an Arabic sibling (Baloo Bhaijaan 2) for the Gulf launch.

styles.name: play-hero
styles.usage: One per screen in the child app: the Today greeting, the end-of-session cheer.

styles.name: play-title
styles.usage: Activity and screen titles in the child app.

styles.name: play-label
styles.usage: Play buttons, card titles and feedback messages.

styles.name: play-number
styles.usage: Numerals in maths games and answer tiles. Use tabular figures in columns.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Andika is designed for beginning readers: single-storey a and g, clear spacing.

styles.name: read-early
styles.sample: The cat sat on a mat.
styles.usage: Anything a 5- to 7-year-old decodes: word tiles, short sentences, letters.

styles.name: read-story
styles.sample: Mia packed three apples and a map for the picnic.
styles.usage: Story and question text for ages 8 to 11. Keep lines to the measure token.

styles.name: site-headline
styles.sample: Games that grow with every child
styles.usage: The website hero headline only. Below 600px wide, step down to play-hero.

groups.name: Family
groups.note: Readex Pro: built for readability, with Arabic in the same family.

styles.name: family-title
styles.usage: Page titles in the parent dashboard and website section titles.

styles.name: family-heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings for parents.

styles.name: family-body
styles.sample: Sara is starting multiplication because she answered 14 of 16 repeated-addition questions correctly on her first try.
styles.usage: All parent and website body copy.

styles.name: family-small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text and table cells.

styles.name: family-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and table headers. Never for sentences.

spacing.note: 4px base. Child screens use the larger steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two touch targets in the child app.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in the parent dashboard; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in the child app; gap between answer tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page bands on the website.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website hero padding.

radius.note: Pebbles, not boxes: everything a child touches is generously rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and checkboxes in the parent dashboard.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Parent buttons and cards; teen (12+) play screens.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Child app cards, answer tiles, play buttons and feedback.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, status chips, avatars and progress dots.

size.note: Minimum sizes for touch and reading.

tokens.name: target-early
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for ages 3 to 5.

tokens.name: target-play
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in the child app from age 6.

tokens.name: target-family
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in the parent dashboard and website.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of an answer tile.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reading and body text.

shadow.note: Play pieces sit on a solid ledge that disappears when pressed. High contrast swaps shadows for 2px borders.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the parental gate: anything floating.

tokens.name: press-depth
tokens.usage: The ledge under play buttons and answer tiles. On press, move the piece down 6px and remove it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 3px ground-coloured gap, then 3px of solid focus colour.
